notes.title: UpGun is part of the 2025 ZLAN !!
notes.content:
As the title says, UpGun will be one of the games played at ZLAN this year, and it’s an extraordinary honor for me to participate in such a big event. Thank you for your trust.

Several things are worth mentioning on this occasion, first of all, new skins!
We will celebrate the ZLAN with new skins available [b]for free[/b] and distributed at the game launch until April 30. [i](the rifle is reserved for DLC owners)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/aac5ea5727a7e3a79e97ac81d08024217a524e41.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977800/UpGun__FullGame/

[b]Changes:[/b]
[i]In order to avoid changing the game meta before the competition, the changes are very subtle and specific.[/i]
[list]
[*] Added an option to hide the interfaces.
[*] The mouse wheel scroll can now be assigned to an action.
[*] Throwing knives and melee attacks are no longer compatible. (picking one would cancel the other)
[*] Eliminations with crampons now grant 250 points (instead of 200).
[*] Player hats now appear on X-ray vision.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eliminations with the voodoo clone now correctly award points.
[*] Fire no longer collides with ghosts.
[*] Fixed the soft lock on jumping.
[*] Self-eliminations with event assets now correctly subtract points.
[*] Rendering optimizations.
[*] Reintegration of the "Guided Bullets" upgrade crosshair.
[*] Fixed the visuals of galaxy armor.
[*] Team colors in first-person view should now be more accurate.
[*] Code and network optimizations.
[/list]

You can find more information on [url=https://zlan.fr/]ZLAN by following this link[/url].

notes.title: UpGun technical changes 2.0.6.1
notes.content:
Hey !
Thank you all for the reception of the last update !

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1575870/view/4182233734644275405

UpGun peaked with [b]220 concurrent players[/b] last week end.

Since I did a lot of work in the last update some issues appeared and were fixed :
[list]
[*] The sensibility wasn't correct when controlling a drone.
[*] The sensibility wasn't set for the first 0.2s after spawning.
[/list]
[u]This was fixed the very next day[/u] on the beta branch. I took a lot of time to rewrite the save system in cpp in order to access it from the base classes of the game code.

Since I rewrote the save, your settings have been reset.

I took some time to also add a very requested feature, deck renaming.
If you play with decks, you can now rename your decks to easily find them.

Other changes :
- Fixed an issue where some players could not access mutators.
- Updated the spoutnik collision.

notes.title: New update ! UpGun goes to space !
notes.content:
Hey !
Long time no see, I had a lot of work on another project (Blood Rush) that required most of my time that past year, but things on cooling down and I was able to cook again for UpGun. So I'm back with a new update with new content!

New content like,
[h1]A brand new map ![/h1]
Discover the [i][b]USS[/b][/i], the UpGun Space Station!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/e7fe045742b3e496d4417945341a2b44e7f37744.png[/img]
The gravity feels lower somehow, but still, be careful to no fall off to the moon.
This is best played with 3-4 players.

[h1]New mutators ![/h1]
This update instead of new upgrades introduces 3 new mutators to spice up your games!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/ab96c22b4341cc73b604d2138c25ca858978e713.png[/img]
[list]
[*][h2]Low gravity (available in the free version)[/h2]
Bring the low gravity from the new Space Station map to the old ones to revisit them!

[*][h2]Grenade spawner[/h2]
You can now turn yourself into a living grenade spawner and spawn a new grenade at your location every 5 secondes!
And obviously these grenades inherit your grenade upgrades.

[*][h2]Only knife[/h2] (by popular demand!)
Take the Gun out of UpGun, and you can only fight your friends with your screw driver.
[/list]


[h2]New cosmetics ![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/56420c46f43995b2f4a8b6dae9df48c2fa4519fd.png[/img]
New cosmetics are available to drop !

I also made some changes to the game, here is the
[h2]Changelog :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the spawn algorythm.
[*] The sensitivity settings affects the controller now. (you might need to reconfigure your sensitivity)
[*] Faster piercing bullets will pierce thicker walls.
[*] Added a trail behind grenades, the trail will adapt to the team color.
[*] Buffed the Pointy Knife upgrade to deal 888 damage on max level.
[*] Added a small Valentine's day seasonnal event.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes :[/h3]
- Fixed an issue when the homing bullets markers showed up in the top left corner of the screen.
- Fixed a typo on the BSOD cosmetic screen (thanks to ZNS for the fixed texture)
- Updated Oil Rig's icon to reflect the finished map design
- Fixed a hole in a ceiling in Oil rig.
- Fixed motion blur option not being saved properly
- Optimized the particle systems
- Added the seasonnal events to Arcadium.
- The team names are now translated in various languages.
- Fixed "WaterCooling" not being really effective.
- Remade all the footsteps code with Easy Foot Step. (my plugin)
- misc fixes

I really hope you like this update ! Another one is coming this summer with a new map, new skills and gifts !

Max'

notes.title: New UpGun Skills ! HIT IT !
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much for the reception of the previous update. This was wild!
The UpGun player base doubled for an entire week!

This week we are releasing another update with new content, new fixes, and balancing!

[h1]New skills ![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/5b897945ed3d7ec02af6f332c935cb1a75f04bf7.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Rifle butt[/b]
Replace your knife attack with a hit from your rifle butt, way easier to aime, way faster, but it does less damage.
[*] [b]Heavy magazine[/b]
Make every bullet count, each bullet contained in your magazine will add more damage if you manage to hit someone with it.
[*] [b]Shotgun fire[/b]
Set enemies on fire with your shotgun.
[/list]


[h3]Balance changes :[/h3]
-[b]IMPORTANT[/b] Killing yourself to get back to full life will now award you -100pts.
-Buffed a bit  [i]Speed is key[/i]. (+5% base damage) 
-Decreased ghost haunting ability cooldown under 4 players.

[h3]Changelog :[/h3]
-Added a Spanish translation !
-Added an Italian translation !
-Added some spawn points for Arcadium.
-The TP disk now have team color variants.
-Added 2 new achievements.


[h3]New skins :[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/935f92f312eb007d3c9972507f26a19fea344d33.png[/img]


[h3]Bug fixes :[/h3]
-The knife could be inspected when thrown.
-Fix various typos and errors in the game texts.
-The Helmet wasn't always showing up.
-The jump boost skill didn't work.
-Fixed collision issues on PP.
-Fixed some OOB exploits.
-Allowed ghost to crouch to get into smaller places.
-Fixed Around the earth achievement to make it faisable.
-Added a close button to avoid getting softlock in a dec kmenu.
-Fixed a glitch making the scoreboard unreadable.

[h3]Side notes :[/h3]
The UpGun plush is stll available here for a few days ! [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/kat-0-dik]Get the Plush to support the game[/url]

Also ! Some members of the community started working on custom maps and mods for UpGun! I did not think it was possible since I did not write explicit mod support, but they managed to do it!

The new version is 2.0.5.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/fed3cf9ec77d9843384c5734c360742597056b59.png[/img]

notes.title: UpGun the Arcadium Update
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the [b]arcadium update[/b] ![/h2]

This year was full of projects for UpGun, and i'm finally glad to present to you what we've been working on lately both ingame and IRL !
This summer we are planning to add a lot of features et new content to UpGun and it starts today ! We release today a brand new map, decks, new skills, 
Two more updates are planned to come out soon !

[h1][b]New map[/b][/h1]
Discover our new arena "Arcadium" a real playground filled with arcades, an escape room and a laser game !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/8b207b044b3c281ff9d65a91e046d3d4055447c7.gif[/img]

Face your friends in the tense laser game room and leave on top ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/65900a5c3b76f8fd878ef5812b1695cc5830b065.png[/img]

I recommend to play with 4 players on this map as you can easily get lost in the laser labyrinth.

[h1][b]New Skills[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/34fe94e68d6a754df292cdc1dabbd0b263dd664b.png[/img]

Try out new skills to surprise your friends !
[list]
[*] [b]Reflected laser[/b] : 
Upgrade your laser to reflect it on surfaces and hit hidden targets !
[*] [b]Piercing laser[/b] : 
Your laser can now hit multiple targets at once, each target multiplies the total damage.
[*] [b][COMPROMISE] Maximum Switfness[/b] : 
Run really fast ! (but slow down is you get hit)
[*] [b]Long slide[/b] : 
Slide, but longer.
[*] [b]Controlled explosion specialist[/b] : 
Your controlled explosion deals 50% less damage to yourself !
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/628250b3a4301917dd3d6c19b16481ddca22f9cd.png[/img]

[h1][b]New limited merch[/b][/h1]
UpGun finally gets unique merch ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/fed3cf9ec77d9843384c5734c360742597056b59.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Get this limited edition plush this [b]now[/b] on [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/kat-0-dik ]MakeShip[/url]
[/list]


[h1]New deck system[/h1]
UpGun (the full version) now has more than 80 unique upgrades. We get that it can be hard to get what you want each round but it is part of the fun ! However, we listened and added a new alternative playstyle using decks.

Play with your friends and a limited deck you chose !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/a748f75d62bf7c26d3994531d436d7be3397b434.png[/img]
[i]Create a deck from the main menu and select one from the lobby menu ![/i]

[h1]New stuff[/h1]

-Added decks to gamemodes
-Added a new animation to inspect your knife
-Added a delay and a progress bar on the lobby button to start a game
-Changed laser visuals
-New achievements
[b]-Added new secrets promo codes[/b]
-New spawn animation

-Optimized UI
-Optimized particle pooling
-More optimizations
-New spawn points on Farm
-Added better air control when dead
-Increased default skills limit to 7 (was 5)
-Increased banned skills limit to 15 (was 10)
-Improved scoreboard
-Improved controller compatibility
-Added partial spanish translation

[h2]New skins[/h2]
Each Update comes with some new skins to customize your character, today we're adding 10 new skins, here they are :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/54b8106bedb44fe5e22587b31a1dd5dc756a9d01.png[/img]
Some of them are available to buy on Steam but you always can drop these ones by playing (also on the free version)


[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

-Buffed default grenades
-Buffed laser damage
-Nerfed Instant grenade
-Buffed anti gravity grenade
-Buffed Jump boost (+40%)
-Buffed magazine size damage bonus for thrown magazines.
-Added a level to jump boost (max level is now 3) 
-Nerfed Auto repair
-"Reset" now gives back a throwing knife

[h3]Bug fixes :[/h3]

-Corrected animation delay on Lasers, grenade launchers and shotguns
-Fixed grenade launcher fire sound spacialisation
-Fixed shrapnel kills not giving points.
-Fixed knife weight painting
-Fixed typo in credits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/0762fda53c2ed99b95f930e83d5fe969aa054b4e.gif[/img]
Thanks Jalal for the animated gif !

New version is 2.0.4.0 !
Max'

notes.title: TIR A L'AVEUGLE !
notes.content:
Hello !
Here is a new update for UpGun!
Improve your upgrades, double the damage of the piercing bullets and the controlled explosion, throw your opponents in the air!

[h1]NEW UPGRADES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/9869e695d7ec32eda2648aeb7426becb80f9719f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved piercing bullets[/b]
Bullets that pierce a wall now do COLOSSAL damage!

SLAM will throw nearby players into the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/3ceffed38be526d2b1d29eab6c545dfa9b7f1c08.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW SKILLS ! Explode on demand !
notes.content:
Hello UpGunners!
We are coming with a new regular update for the summer! And as usual, it contains new skills, cosmetics and various fixes.

[h2]NEW IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/2254a4147f6c3205dd7f5cbbebcb62cb19f8ffc8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Shooting decoy[/b]
Spawn your decoy to shoot at your opponents! Each bullet deals 10 points of damage and everything is shot in a straight line. Make your friends doubt you and take them out!

[*] [b]Controlled explosion[/b]
Explode at will like "last flame", but live!
You will inflict as much damage as you have health points, after the explosion you are left with 1 HP. 

[*] [b]Boomerang[/b]
Your bullets come back to you, very dangerous but very convenient to set traps at the turn.
[/list]


[h2]NEW FREE UPGRADE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/c3095d4e46bc3c514a555c1322f11ad1a6eeaf8f.png[/img]
Free UpGun players can now play with "Lucky day" and increase the chance of each shot to shoot critical bullet.

[h2]NEW COSMETICS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/4ecb3d7a185a9cab74a386c88e1edf28fae057bf.png[/img]
Some of these new cosmetics are available for purchase on Steam!

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
-Throwing your magazine now deals a lot more damage.
-The knife leaves a small mark on the walls now.
-Some interactive items now shake when activated.
-4 new achievements!

[Bug fixes:[/b]
-The treadmill on Everstopped was not working
-Skills were sometimes ported in the lobby
-You were not able to inspect your weapon in the lobby
-Equivalent exchange was not working properly

Max'

notes.title: UpGun is FIRE (new skills)
notes.content:
[h1][b]FIRE![/b][/h1]
Fire UpGun with the arrival of a new element!

Coming with the update, are not 3, but 4 new skills related to this theme! I hope they will allow you to try new combos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/92d6b8eb3b6cc9709fdfc68eb0489dd4f0b82fb8.png[/img]

[h1][b]4 NEW SKILLS:[/b][/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/b0e201a4baf8c747009dcde0d315e44664fc6e4b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/b0e201a4baf8c747009dcde0d315e44664fc6e4b.gif[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [b]Fire bullets[/b]
Your bullets ignite your enemies on contact.

[*] [b]Watercooled Armor[/b]
Cool your armor and get a huge reduction in fire damage.

[*] [b]Incendiary Grenade[/b]
Take advantage of your grenades and ignite an area to burn your opponents!

[*] [b]Flire Dash[/b]
Dash and leave a trail of fire behind you!
[/list]

[h1]New free Skill![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/8e21cea09420959453c413e34c9465e2b667ae8b.png[/img]

Sacrifice half of your life bar to ensure a minimum life base after each elimination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/d951459bdc09cbb6568ca81f341496c5ff3ef5d0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/549c689f46c31936545bb41300550170aa4956b0.png[/img]

Fire extinguishers put out the fire:

-Fixed some achievements.

-Local boost level 2 no longer causes crashes.
-Local boost level 1 doesn't make you invincible anymore (phew)
-Skills are no longer restored in the lobby after a game
-The use of the local boost could softlock the player

May the fire be with you!

notes.title: NEW SKILLS ! Throw your magazine !
notes.content:
The first of the regular updates is here!
We've been pushing a few patches since the release of the big update on June 8th and today we're bringing you some new content!

[h1]Check out and try 3 new skills![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/2390381c8812a8469b2cf8641920e4017ef4ba93.png[/img]

Try them with the full version of the game:
[list]
[*] [b]Flying magazine![/b]
Turn your moment of weakness into an opportunity, during your reload, grab your magazine and throw it at your opponent.
The magazine defaults to 15 damage, but the bigger it is, the more damage it does.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/bb0fa7d51cc27a7f230081e5be179077b6fff34c.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Last grenade[/b]
Leave behind a little souvenir. The dropped grenade uses the upgrades you have.

[*] [b]Sharpened Grapple[/b]
Throwing a grappling hook through a player deals damage, equip this upgrade to deal 25 points of damage by running it through a player.
[/list]

[h2]New available skill for the free version ![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/6898e7dce11396f09849f85e0c6834f141bda63a.png[/img]
Enjoy a new upgrade even without paying for the game, increase the damage you do in the head!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New gifted skins![/h2]

If you own EverStopped, you will receive up to 3 new skins for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/e7eaa8d51ba503941d00615a41f726a542005583.png[/img]
Armor is given to all EverStopped players!
Weapon skins are given to EverStopped [b]AND [/b]UpGun owners!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101180/EverStopped/

[h2]New skins ![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/51dd7dc0a0304ae0779ad445cd860e4864702292.png[/img]
Also enjoy the new droppable skins from the update by playing the game, trading and on the community marketplace.
Until the next update some of these skins will be available for purchase on the UpGun Steam page!

[hr][/hr]

[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The kill feed icons are bigger to be more readable.
[*] New texture for the laser sight.
[*] Using "Charged spray" without having ammo reduces its cooldown to 1sec.
[*] Damage inflicted by the voodoo clone is displayed around the player who shot it.
[*] German translation coming soon!
[*] 2 new achievements!
[*] 1 new trophy!
[/list]

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some hats did not have a preview.
[*] Some armor was not the right color in game.
[*] Fixed untimely reloads at the spawn when it lags.
[*] You couldn't have several extensions on the weapon.
[*] Generators were not replicated correctly.
[*] You could give yourself more than 3 extensions
[/list]

notes.title: UPGUN 2.0 IS AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[b][h1]THE UPDATE IS HERE! [/h1][/b]
And more than an update, the game code has been completely rewritten from scratch to accommodate future updates. That's why it took us so long.
The game is also free to play now! 
[i]more info here : [/i]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1575870/view/3211639524384367098

[h1]New game mode![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/a22c6c9f9d25a7163f3aa8413a049ad9a3e4ad2a.png[/img]
Now play in [b]Team Deathmatch[/b] for up to 8 players! Choose your team and cooperate with your friends to subdue your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/38a51234257bb7907c522f036ea8cf3d3a48bcc8.png[/img]
[h1]Take advantage of the new gamemode specific skills![/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]LOCAL BUFF[/b]
Apply a boost to nearby players and yourself for 10 seconds.

The first level increases:
[list]
[*] Damage by 12.5%.
[*] Jump height by 10%.
[/list]
Second level increases:
[list]
[*] Damage by 15%.
[*] Jump height by 10%.
[*] Speed by 7.5%
[*] Life by 15 hp
[/list]

[*] [b]LOCAL BUFF MULTIPLIER[/b] [i](requires local buff)[/i]
Increase the power of your buff based on the number of players affected, group together for a much more powerful buff!

[*] [b]HEALING BULLETS[/b]
Grant the ability for your bullets to heal your allies by shooting them!
[/list]


[h2]New map![/h2]
Fight on an oil rig! Probably the safest place to fight, just don't shoot the red barrels nor lean over the barriers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/49bb4758afc5b517a2217c6c712a0864db78ae01.png[/img]
The platform is composed of 3 floors all connected by several paths, a basement, a crane and a control station. It is probably the biggest map yet !

[h2]6 NEW SKILLS[/h2]
([i]In addition to the gamemode specific skill.[/i])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/3daea883387a82622272e4aa20dfafad89b1e227.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Charged spray[/b] (Ability)
Compress your weapon and empty your magazine in one go to overwhelm your opponents!

[*] [b]Self Repair[/b] (Ability)
Learn to repair yourself.

[*] [b]Heavy Bullets[/b] (Weapon upgrade)
Your bullets will be larger, deal more damage and will be affected by gravity.

[*] [b]Better Crits[/b] (Weapon Upgrade)
Boost the damage of your critical bullets.

[*] [b]Anti-Gravity Grenade[/b] (Grenade upgrade)

[*] [b]Sniper[/b] (Compromise)
Long distance shots deal way more damage ! (like way more if you do it)
[/list]

[h2]BALANCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Last Flame does less damage.
[*] Omniscient no longer shows skills, but shows the life bar of nearby players.
[*] Piercing bullets can pierce thicker walls if they go fast enough.
[*] Redesigned the spawn code.
[*] You get a life bonus at spawn.
[*] Shooting a teleportation disk is now worth 180 points.
[*] Removed "Life Exchange".
[/list]

[h2]IMPLEMENTATION OF MUTATORS[/h2]
In order to allow you to adjust your experience on UpGun as much as possible, in addition to the already existing settings, the update brings the support of mutators. The mutators are there to add or change a rule of the game in order to let you customize them more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/09d93e96279eef855d546af52e42d7eb45b8baf2.png[/img]

The update comes with 3 mutators:
[list]
[*] [b]Mystery cards[/b]
The distributed cards are hidden.

[*] [b]Big heads[/b]
Double the size of the robots head.

[*] [b]One shot[/b]
The slightest damage is fatal!
[/list]

[h2]NEW FEATURES[/h2]
Since the game was recoded from scratch, in addition to restoring the old features, we decided to improve the existing ones and add a few more.

[list]
[*] [b]New lighting system[/b]
The game's lighting has been completely redesigned to support a day/night cycle system and more accurate indoor lighting.

[*] [b]New damage indicators[/b]
Now your health is visible around the screen, cracks appear when you take damage. 
In addition to that, an effect appears indicating the origin of the damage you take.

[*] [b]Interface redesigns[/b]
Many of the game's interfaces have been redesigned to be more readable, more efficient or just more aesthetic. The menus that have changed the most are: the game creation menu, the scoreboard and the game creation settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/ddf66bc4e9450d8c38aee48f9ac330e374a9f355.png[/img]
[i](You can now specify the desired level of default skills)[/i]

[*] [b]Fire extinguishers can explode[/b]
Fire extinguishers can now explode and put out nearby fires.

[*] [b]New rendering option[/b]
If your PC supports it, a new rendering option has been added to enable additional lighting.

[*] [b]And more to come![/b]
In the coming months we will release several (free) updates with new skills to renew the list regularly! 
[/list]

[h2]FREE ARMOR[/h2]
If you owned UpGun before the update or if you buy the DLC, you will earn an exclusive armor only available temporarily.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/b1f76fe459fefc40872ea20ebbb02527684dc4c1.png[/img]
[i](the armor is available from June 8th to June 22nd, just launch the game to unlock it. Restarting the game is necessary to see it appear in the ingame inventory)[/i]

[h3]Other additions:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 19 new achievements
[*] Mapping is now automatically saved
[*] New animations for the dash and slide
[*] Spectators now appear as drones
[*] New assets added to old maps
[*] Added a Z-kill
[*] Added a custom cursor to UpGun
[*] Fireflies can appear at night on maps with greenery
[*] Added a random event on the farm map
[*] Added about 40 new cosmetics
[*] New ambient sounds
[*] Chameleon armor is no longer droppable (you keep it if you have it)
[*] New IK system for the robot's legs
[*] Explosions can now deflect projectiles
[*] New hit sound
[*] New sound effects
[*] You can now ban players from your lobby
[*] You can now kick or ban players from your game while playing
[*] 2 new unlockable trophies on the game menu
[*] Added a player ID verification system. [i](contact me if you think you need to be verified)[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Big optimization of particle systems
[*] Huge network optimization
[*] Animation optimization
[*] Compressions of some textures
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
The game has been recoded in its entirety, the bugs mentioned here that appeared before on UpGun are not all really corrected, but they are absent from the new version of the game (the result is the same, these bugs are no longer there)

[list]
[*] Incoherent shadows fixed
[*] Correction of the ping value
[*] Fixed the idle animation that was sliding a bit
[*] Fixed the bug that displayed different leading players when the scores were equal.
[*] The ball in the lobby no longer pushes the players up
[*] Fixed persistent inputs.
[/list]

If you have the free version of UpGun, some of the content of the update is only available here :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1977800/UpGun__FullGame/

Thanks for the support !

notes.title: UPGUN IS GOING FREE TO PLAY
notes.content:
Hello !
The most requested thing about UpGun will be answered; [h2]the game is going free to play![/h2]
[u](Changes will be made when the major update is released on June 8)[/u]

[h1]That's it, you will be able to try and play UpGun for free![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/876884a188e20065db09007cb4c066f203649686.png[/img]

[h1]What changes?[/h1]
Not much, except that everyone can now play the game, and enjoy many of the new features of the update!

The free version of UpGun gives access to:
[list]
[*] [b]The creation of servers[/b]
[*] [b]3 maps[/b]
[*] [b]50 upgrades[/b]
[*] Access to cosmetics (and future cosmetics)
[*] Support and patches
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/fd6fe37deaa05e3aa4b33fc62c134b6e1e836015.png[/img]
(list of improvements available in the free version)

[h1]If you had bought UpGun[/h1]
[b]If you had purchased UpGun[/b]; in this case you have access to additional content and many exclusives!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/0217bfb0f2edde48c242a7fd4804f3976ce614ac.png[/img]
[list]
[*] More than 20 additional skills!
[*] Access to all features of the game.
[*] Access to the list of public servers.
[*] Access to all mutators.
[*] Access to all maps.
[*] Exclusive cosmetics!
[*] Access to all future UpGun content (excluding potential DLCs)[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/b1f76fe459fefc40872ea20ebbb02527684dc4c1.png[/img]
[i](This will drop between July 8th and 22nd)[/i]

But above all, the 2 versions of the game are compatible, you just have to choose which type of lobby is created in the server cration menu here :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/0a06066a7979a4fd0e1ad287d62cfb27921eae4a.png[/img]
For people playing the free game, the option will be grayed out and will only be able to join servers with the option unchecked.


Be ready for June 8, when the change will happen!

Max'

notes.title: What's next for UpGun
notes.content:
Hello !
The game is not dead, and neither are we.
We start to see the light at the end of the tunnel and we have great news to announce for UpGun!

We decided to cancel the update of last September to focus on a very very big project for UpGun, [b]a complete refactoring of the code[/b] and everything that goes with it.
It means that we started the project from scratch again and it took a lot of time and work.

Even if UpGun was working very well under the hood, here is what you can expect as a result of the refactoring :
A better network code :
[list]
[*] Improved latency.
[*] More consistent replication.
[/list]

Better overall code structure:
[list]
[*] Better flexibility for future updates.
[*] Support for new skills.
[*] Support for new game modes.
[/list]

For the moment, the release of the update is not yet announced because we want to be sure to release it on the most stable version possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/49bb4758afc5b517a2217c6c712a0864db78ae01.png[/img]

[h2]Here's what we have planned for the update![/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]A BRAND NEW MAP![/b]
[list]
[*] The oil rig will be able to accommodate up to 8 players !
[*] I think the team there forgot to remove the explosive barrels
[/list]
[*] [b]MUTATOR SUPPORT[/b]
[list]
[*] UpGun will support mutators to let you customize your games
[/list]
[*] [b]NEW GAME MODE![/b]
[list]
[*] The "Team Death Match" game mode will come with this update!
[/list]
[*] New improvements
[*] New cosmetics.
[/list]

And many other new features are planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/91dc321504f9c9f3e0ba26e9da17b56b73424607.png[/img]

See you soon!

notes.title: UpGun 1.1.3 (Patch note 3)

-Spam crouch to climb unwalkable areas is a thing of the past.
-Added some icons for bindings.
-Exploit on game settings fixed.

-Some sound effects were playing when they should not be in the lobby.
-Server names are now limited in length.
-Bullets did not bounce in the Everstopped offices.

notes.title: UpGun patch 1.1.1

Second patchnote !

Less consequent this time, there are less issues than the first day!

notes.title: Day one patch
notes.content:
Hello ! 
The game has just been released and we are very happy to see that you really like it! Your feedback is really cool!

On top of that, you found a lot of little problems with the game, and that's normal it's just been released and we're a very small team!

So we've been working hard to give you a better experience!

We also noticed that some of you were frustrated playing in public servers when the game is more oriented towards playing with friends. That's why there's an addition in this patch.

Change:
-Added a list of friends connected to UpGun in the Lobby to more easily invite your Steam friends.
-Removed the "Join Game" button because people thought it was matchmaking and found it frustrating.
-Added more error messages when logging out.
-Added a border for the spectator HUD.


Bugs fixed:
-Fixed a bug on the audio of the hangar doors
-Mouse sensitivity is also applied to ghosts now !
-The back button is back (on the password menu)
-Spectators will no longer be able to escape from the cards!
-The spectator could not move sometimes
-The spectators have the same sensitivity as the player.
-The spectators have a set of keys modelled on the player's.
-Fixed several Out Of Bounds feats
-Fixed a possible soft lock with the weapon extensions.
-Fixed a bug in the animation of weapon extensions.
_Cheat vulnerability patched.
-Persistent tooltips will not happen anymore!


Some typos have been fixed too!

notes.title: UpGun is now available on Steam !
notes.content:
Get ready!

UpGun is coming to Steam!

Compete against your friends in an arena by equipping abilities and upgrades! Create your own strategies using the skills you are given!

I'm so happy to release the game. For those who have been following the adventure on Youtube, you know how far we've come!
[previewyoutube=CoWfvZyVpp8;full][/previewyoutube]

We're launching the game and we hope you like it!
We currently have :
[list]
[*] More than 55 upgrades available!
[*] 4 maps!
[*] More than 165 cosmetics! 
[*] 78 achievements and 7 trophies on the menu.
[*] An interactive lobby with a parkour for the real G@MERZ.
[/list]

We really spent a lot of time on the game and I hope you like it.

A lot of people even BEFORE the release of the game have asked us [b]what our plans are for the next game[/b].

UpGun 2 is coming out next year.
Well, no, but we are planning a big restructuration of the code to further optimize the game and open it up to new horizons with new game modes. We have a lot of ideas for the future but we hope you'll like the game already at launch!


Max'
